Sealed)</dd><dt>Private Bid:</dt><dd>No</dd></dl></div></div></div></div><h2 class="MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-h2 mui-emotion-css-1jnid2k">Overview</h2><div class="introduction-subsection"><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-12"><h4 class="introduction-subsection-title">Summary</h4></div></div><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-12"><div class="introduction-description article" style="white-space: pre-wrap;"><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: 11pt;"><strong><span style="font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%;">2026 Supportive Housing Notice of Funding Availability </span></strong></p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: 11pt;">OC HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT (OCHCD) announces the release of the 2026 Supportive Housing Notice of Funding Availability (NOFA) making available up to $20.9 million dollars of Federal HOME Investment Partnership Program (HOME), HOME American Rescue Plan Program (HOME-ARP), Mental Health Services Act (MHSA)/Behavioral Health Services Act (BHSA), 15G Reserves and Housing Successor Agency (HSA) Funds, to promote the acquisition, new construction, and acquisition/rehabilitation of Supportive Housing and will also provide up to 100 Housing Choice, Mainstream and/or Veterans Affairs Supportive Housing Project Based Vouchers for extremely low-income households who are homeless.</p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: 11pt;">Funds are available until the NOFA closes, is replaced by a new NOFA, or until all available funds are committed via Board of Supervisors action, whichever occurs first. Interested and qualified applicants who can successfully demonstrate their ability to provide supportive housing for extremely low-income households who are experiencing homelessness are encouraged to submit proposals.</p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: 11pt;">Small-scale housing is an eligible activity under this NOFA, so long as it meets NOFA criteria and the guiding principles in the Commission to Address Homelessness Small-Scale Housing Unit Report received and filed by the Board of Supervisors on January 28, 2025.</p><p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 11pt;">The NOFA is available at the following County website links:</p><p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 11pt;">OpenGov NOFA 2026-01: <a style="color: blue; text-decoration: underline;" href="https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov/projects/210644">https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov/projects/210644</a></p><p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 11pt;">OCHCD Website: <a style="color: blue; text-decoration: underline;" href="https://www.ochcd.org/housing-development/developer/notice-funding-availability">https://www.ochcd.org/housing-development/developer/notice-funding-availability</a></p><p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;</p><p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 11pt;">Please refer any questions to:</p><p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;</p><p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 11pt;">Sherluna Vien</p><p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 11pt;">OC Housing &amp; Community Development</p><p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 11pt;">1501 E. href="mailto:sherluna.vien@occr.ocgov.com">sherluna.vien@occr.ocgov.com</a></p><p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 11pt;">Office: (714) 480-2936</p><p style="margin: 0in; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;</p><p
